title: Malaysian Satay with Peanut Sauce
description: Grilled meat skewers served with a creamy and nutty peanut sauce, inspired by Malaysian street food.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, peanut butter, lime juice, honey, ginger, garlic, and coriander. Blend until smooth.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the marinade ingredients. Add the beef or chicken and mix until well coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated meat onto skewers.
6. Grill the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, cook the peanut sauce over low heat, whisking constantly, until heated through.
8. Serve the satay with peanut sauce and garnish with cilantro.
